description: Revert to the Depth=8 configuration with Matrix LR=0.08 and Embedding LR=0.6 which achieved the best result (0.9878), but increase the device batch size from 128 to 160 to improve data throughput and MFU, potentially allowing the model to see more tokens within the 5-minute budget and converge further, while staying within the ~76GB VRAM limit.
